name: Implicit Subsystem Parameterization
description: Instead of explicitly presenting the modified bounds $2T - p_{1,i}$ and the exact subsets of inequalities, we define the entire constraint system as a single parameterized relation. We introduce a symmetric margin function $S(w, q)$ to compress the upper and lower bounds. The certificates are then defined as the unsatisfiability of this relation under specific partial evaluations. This forces the model to perform algebraic substitution and resolve the min-function to discover the 1D packing and sum conditions, breaking the direct pattern match on the certificate descriptions.
